text:
ayesha: Quick sync — finalizing the Optimize toolkit roadmap slice for the quarter. Need to lock which items are GA vs v1.1. My proposed GA gates: batching recommendations (UI + infra), prompt-set pinning with traces, and basic regression alerts. Thoughts?

tom: +1 on batching recs and KV cache visibility as GA. If customers can't see why batching changed, they won't adopt it.

ravi: Regression alerts are critical. We need model-level baselines in the evals pipeline so alerts aren't just noise.

lina: From customer signals (Acme, Nova) they expect to pin prompt sets to a rollout and see failure traces. They explicitly listed that as GA-level.

joan: From research POV: lightweight regression detection (ngram drift + eval harness delta) doable in ~2 sprints; full orchestrated eval infra is ~4 sprints. Recommend staging gating for GA and full infra post-GA.

ayesha: Proposed gating for GA: (1) batching_recs UI + infra (read-only recs OK), (2) prompt_set pin + traces, (3) regression_alerts_basic (threshold alerts). Backlog/next: auto-quant suggestions, advanced A/B routing.

tom: Implementation risk: exposing a "batchability" score touches runtime. We can ship recommendations-only initially (no runtime enforcement) to reduce risk.

ravi: Agree — recommend "recommendation mode" for initial release. For regressions, minimum viable data: (model_id, promptset_id, rolling_avg_score, delta_pct). Alert when delta_pct > 7% (TBD).

ayesha: @ravi what metric do we standardize on? Perplexity is noisy for open-gen.

ravi: Use task-specific evals when available (BLEU/ROUGE for translation/summarization), and a composite quality score from the eval harness otherwise. For open gen, prefer human-calibrated QA metric.

joan: Also need clear ownership for prompt sets: suggestion is solutions + customers can submit; Product curates canonical sets and flags curated_vs-customer.

lina: Will customers be able to "lock" a prompt set for a rollout? We should add lock/unlock perms in the first ship.

ayesha: Draft launch checklist (gates) — adding here so we can iterate:

```
{
  "gates": [
    "batching_recs_ui",
    "kv_cache_visibility",
    "promptset_pin_and_traces",
    "regression_alerts_basic",
    "eval_baseline_store",
    "docs_and_sdk_examples"
  ]
}
```

tom: Rough timeline estimate: 2 sprints for recs UI + infra, 2 sprints for promptset pinning + traces, 1 sprint for alerts baseline. Total ~5 sprints -> likely GA end-of-quarter.

ayesha: We'll need single sign-off from PM + Eng + Research for GA. Also need to capture customer-critical asks in a priority matrix — @lina can you compile account-level impact/asks?

lina: Yep, I'll compile a priority matrix and send by EOD Friday.

joan: Suggest adding an eval sample-size gate: only trigger regression alerts if n >= 100 examples or another stability threshold.

ayesha: Noted and added to the checklist. Thanks! :thumbsup:

prio-bot: Reminder: add OKR tag 'opt-toolkit' to the epic and link the product PRD.

ayesha: Action items: lina -> priority matrix from accounts; tom -> spike runtime changes for batchability; ravi -> propose initial quality score formula; joan -> sample-size threshold proposal. Will reconvene after matrix lands.

lina: Got it, will DM follow-ups.

tom: I'll start the runtime spike tomorrow morning.

ravi: Drafting the composite quality score today, will share notebook.

ayesha: Thanks everyone — aim to lock scope by next Wed so we can align OKRs.
